title: Vehicle has parked or stopped by roadside yet the traffic signal does not know.
situation: Vehicle has parked or stopped by roadside yet the traffic signal does not know.
entities: 1. Traffic signal 2. Vehicle which has stopped/parked.
description: A vehicle looking for parking spot has successfully landed one thus stopped but still being counted as traffic flow.
dialogue_prompts: 1. Is there a conflict? No, We only have to update traffic signal with current status of parking spaces. 2. Is there a common problem to be solved? No, only traffic signal is concerned with updating its information
source_proposed_solutions: 1. Vehicle informs the traffic at both ends of the road stretch that it has parked thus must be counted out of traffic flow.
peas: 1. Performance Measure - If a vehicle has entered a parking space, traffic signal must be immediately updated with information so new vehicles desiring to park can be redirected as needed. 2. Environment - A vehicle has parked in a parking space successfully. 3. Actuator - Deceleration Mechanism in the vehicle, Parking Detection sensor transmitter 4. Sensor - Parking detection sensor, Traffic signal’s receiver
cascading_problems: 1. Vehicle in parked state is willing to commence motion but does not inform the traffic signal thus disrupting real traffic flow (Discussed).
